allow: Shared cross-task evidence, uncertainty, safety, and evaluation instructions
Current episode observations and tool contracts
exclude: Task-specific coordinates, distances, speeds, tolerances, or timeouts

trace_requirements: Save exact rendered prompt and template hash
Preserve raw inputs, outputs, frames, tool results, and evaluator verdict for every run
interpretation: Do not present prescribed execution as autonomous VLM planning
Do not equate IK reachability with physical contact
A control or safety restriction is not a task-solving recipe
Separate prompt, tool-contract, geometry, and model changes when attributing gains
